process_area.title: Variable Pay, Incentives & Total Rewards Strategy

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, CHRO, Finance (links to VS-17.4), Payroll (links to VS-19.2), Managers, Compensation Committee (links to VS-36)

workflows.name: Short-Term Incentive (STI) / Bonus Plan Design & Administration

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-measure of "C&B Manager/CHRO design the STI/bonus plan" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate affordability vs budget" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-calculate of "calculate payouts, Payroll" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-537 (ensure controlled execution — Variable Pay, Incentives & Total Rewards Strategy (PA-102.3).)
- operational: funding formula and approval; operational: clear measures and calibration
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over/under-funding risk**: Payouts misaligned to performance/budget; mitigated by funding formula and approval
- **Pay-for-performance-dilution risk**: Weak linkage rewards low performers; mitigated by clear measures and calibration
System Touchpoints: - Incentive planning; CPM (links to VS-33.2); payroll (links to VS-19.2); tax (links to VS-79); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: C&B Manager/CHRO design the STI/bonus plan: eligibility, performance measures (corporate, business-unit, individual links to VS-19.4 performance), weighting, targets/funding formula, cap, and payout curve; align to corporate performance (links to VS-33.2)

Finance/C&B Manager compute plan funding against actual performance (links to VS-33.2 CPM), validate affordability vs budget (W3327), and obtain committee/CEO approval (links to VS-36); model payout scenarios

Managers assign individual performance ratings (links to VS-19.4); C&B Manager calculate payouts, Payroll (links to VS-19.2) executes with tax (links to VS-79), communicate to employees, and audit for governance (links to VS-21.1)

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, Sales/Trade leadership (links to VS-11/VS-43), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Payroll (links to VS-19.2), Sales Ops
fields.Trigger: Annual plan; new sales motion (trade per VS-43, project per VS-11)

workflows.name: Sales Commission & Trade-Incentive Plan Design, Calculation & Payout

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "C&B Manager/Sales leadership design the commission/trade-incentive plan" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate against quotas/credit rules, handle disputes, and reconcile to…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System continuous audit of "audit plan cost vs budget" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-537 (ensure controlled execution — Variable Pay, Incentives & Total Rewards Strategy (PA-102.3).)
- operational: documented attribution rules; operational: margin-weighted design (links to VS-101)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Dispute-heavy risk**: Unclear credit rules cause disputes; mitigated by documented attribution rules
- **Margin-blind incentive risk**: Revenue-only commission erodes margin; mitigated by margin-weighted design (links to VS-101)
System Touchpoints: - Commission/sales-performance module; O2C (links to VS-16); POS/analytics (links to VS-08); payroll (links to VS-19.2)

steps.activity: C&B Manager/Sales leadership design the commission/trade-incentive plan: quota setting, rate structures (tiered, accelerator), SPIFs, credit/attribution rules (per account/order links to VS-11.2/VS-16), clawback, and cap; align to margin not just revenue (links to VS-101 margin)

Sales Ops/Finance compute commissions from sales results (links to VS-16 O2C/VS-08 POS), validate against quotas/credit rules, handle disputes, and reconcile to revenue/margin; obtain sales-leadership approval
Payroll (links to VS-19.2) executes commission payout with tax (links to VS-79); C&B Manager audit plan cost vs budget (W3327) and effectiveness (W3328) and adjust the plan

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, Store Ops (links to VS-07), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Payroll (links to VS-19.2), Store Managers

workflows.name: Store/Team Performance Bonus & Gainshare Plan Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-measure of "C&B Manager/Store Ops design store/team bonus and gainshare plans" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "approve payouts within budget" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track store-bonus cost and effectiveness on store KPIs" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-537 (ensure controlled execution — Variable Pay, Incentives & Total Rewards Strategy (PA-102.3).)
- operational: balanced measures and audit (links to VS-21); operational: like-for-like ranking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Gaming risk**: Stores game measures (e.g., suppress returns) for bonus; mitigated by balanced measures and audit (links to VS-21.1)
- **Inequity risk**: Format/cluster differences make payout unfair; mitigated by like-for-like ranking
System Touchpoints: - Store-performance/analytics (links to VS-07/VS-33.2); payroll (links to VS-19.2); shrink (links to VS-23); inventory (links to VS-05)

steps.activity: C&B Manager/Store Ops design store/team bonus and gainshare plans: measures (sales per store, margin, shrink control links to VS-23, inventory accuracy links to VS-05.1, customer satisfaction links to VS-13), weighting, and payout

Store Ops/Finance compute store/team performance vs targets (links to VS-33.2), allocate bonus pool by store ranking, and approve payouts within budget (W3327); manage fairness across store formats/clusters (links to VS-101.2 W3302)
Payroll (links to VS-19.2) executes payout; C&B Manager track store-bonus cost and effectiveness on store KPIs (shrink, accuracy, CSAT) and retention (W3328)

fields.Participants: CHRO, C&B Manager, Legal (links to VS-100), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Compensation Committee (links to VS-36)

workflows.name: Long-Term Incentive (LTI), Retention & Recognition Program Design

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "Legal/Finance structure awards" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track LTI liability and report to committee and audit" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-537 (ensure controlled execution — Variable Pay, Incentives & Total Rewards Strategy (PA-102.3).)
- operational: award structure approved at the committee gate (step 2) with documented vesting and finance/legal review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Retention-failure risk**: Poorly designed LTI fails to retain key talent; mitigated by market benchmarking and vesting design
- **Accounting-error risk**: Wrong PFRS expense recognition distorts financials; mitigated by finance/legal review
System Touchpoints: - LTI/equity platform; governance (links to VS-36); PFRS (links to VS-17.1); payroll (links to VS-19.2); legal (links to VS-100)

steps.activity: CHRO/C&B Manager design LTI and retention programs for executives/key talent (phantom equity, performance shares, retention bonus, cliff vesting) benchmarked to market (W3308); align to long-term corporate strategy (links to VS-33)

Legal/Finance structure awards (PFRS expense recognition links to VS-17.1, vesting conditions, performance conditions, documentation, tax links to VS-79); obtain committee/board approval (links to VS-36)
C&B Manager administer vesting, performance certification, forfeiture, and payout via payroll (links to VS-19.2); track LTI liability and report to committee and audit (links to VS-21.1)

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, HRBP, Internal Comms (links to VS-103.2), Payroll (links to VS-19.2), Employees
fields.Trigger: Annual; on hire; on major change

workflows.name: Total Rewards Statement Generation & Value-Proposition Communication

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-compile of "compile each employee's total rewards" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-generate of "generate personalized total-rewards statements and communicate the employee…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-measure of "measure statement/EVP impact on engagement" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-537 (ensure controlled execution — Variable Pay, Incentives & Total Rewards Strategy (PA-102.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Underappreciation risk**: Employees underestimate total package; mitigated by clear statements
- **Data-accuracy risk**: Wrong statement values erode trust; mitigated by reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - Total-rewards platform; payroll/HRIS (links to VS-19.2/VS-29.2); self-service (links to VS-103.1)

steps.activity: C&B Manager compile each employee's total rewards: base pay, STI/LTI value, statutory employer contributions (W3314), HMO/medical (W3313), retirement (W3315), allowances (W3316), wellness/EAP (W3317), training (links to VS-19.4), and time-off value

C&B Manager/Internal Comms generate personalized total-rewards statements and communicate the employee value proposition (EVP); deliver via employee self-service (links to VS-103.1) and onboarding (links to VS-19.1)
C&B Manager measure statement/EVP impact on engagement (links to VS-103.2) and retention (W3328); refine messaging and offerings

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, HRBP, Managers, Employees, Internal Comms (links to VS-103.2), Payroll (links to VS-19.2)

Automation Opportunity: - System rule-based auto-approval of "Managers/peers nominate and approve recognition" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track recognition participation/equity across stores/roles, measure engagement…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-537 (ensure controlled execution — Variable Pay, Incentives & Total Rewards Strategy (PA-102.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Inequity risk**: Recognition concentrated in few roles/locations; mitigated by equity monitoring
- **Budget-overrun risk**: Spot awards exceed budget; mitigated by controls (W3327)
System Touchpoints: - Recognition platform; payroll (links to VS-19.2); comms/engagement (links to VS-103.2); HRIS (links to VS-29.2)

steps.activity: C&B Manager design/maintain recognition programs (peer-to-peer, manager awards, service anniversaries, spot awards, values awards); set criteria, nomination workflow, and budget (W3327)

Managers/peers nominate and approve recognition; C&B Manager administer awards (monetary via payroll links to VS-19.2, non-monetary, ceremonies), service-anniversary milestones, and communication (links to VS-103.2)
C&B Manager track recognition participation/equity across stores/roles, measure engagement impact (links to VS-103.2), and report program effectiveness (W3328)

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, CHRO, Finance/FP&A (links to VS-17.4), CFO, Entity HR leads
fields.Trigger: Annual budget cycle (links to VS-33.1); reforecast

workflows.name: Compensation & Benefits Budget Planning, Forecasting & Spend Control

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "review affordability vs revenue/EBITDA" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-monitor of "monitor actual C&B spend vs budget monthly, reforecast quarterly, manage…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-122 (ensure pay equity & statutory benefits compliance.)
- operational: gates and monthly monitoring; operational: scenario planning (W3328)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Budget-overrun risk**: Merit/benefit cost exceeds plan; mitigated by gates and monthly monitoring
- **Under-investment risk**: Over-tight budget loses competitiveness; mitigated by scenario planning (W3328)
System Touchpoints: - Compensation planning; FP&A (links to VS-17.4); payroll (links to VS-19.2); CPM (links to VS-33.2)

steps.activity: C&B Manager/Finance build the annual C&B budget: merit increase (W3311), structure movement (W3307), STI/LTI funding (W3321/W3324), benefits cost (W3320), allowances/recognition (W3316/W3326); align to corporate labor budget (links to VS-33.1)
CHRO/CFO review affordability vs revenue/EBITDA (links to VS-33), approve budget and envelopes per entity, and set spend-control gates for merit/hire/promotion
C&B Manager/Finance monitor actual C&B spend vs budget monthly, reforecast quarterly, manage exceptions (W3311 outliers, W3321 funding), and report to CHRO/CFO

fields.Participants: C&B Manager, People Analytics (links to VS-103.3), CHRO, BI (links to VS-28.1)
fields.Trigger: Annual review; turnover trigger (links to VS-19.5)

workflows.name: Total Rewards Effectiveness, Engagement-Link & Retention Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-measure of "measure total-rewards effectiveness" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-identify of "identifying reward drivers of attrition" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-allocate of "reallocate spend to high-impact rewards" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-537 (ensure controlled execution — Variable Pay, Incentives & Total Rewards Strategy (PA-102.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Effectiveness-blindness risk**: Spending on rewards without measuring impact; mitigated by analytics
- **Regrettable-loss risk**: Losing high performers to compensation gaps; mitigated by retention analytics
System Touchpoints: - People analytics (links to VS-103.3); BI (links to VS-28.1); engagement (links to VS-103.2); turnover (links to VS-103.3)

steps.activity: C&B Manager/People Analytics measure total-rewards effectiveness: pay competitiveness vs market (W3308), pay-equity (W3309), benefits utilization/satisfaction (W3320), incentive ROI (W3321/W3322/W3323), and recognition reach (W3326)

C&B Manager/People Analytics correlate rewards with engagement (links to VS-103.2) and turnover/retention (links to VS-19.5/VS-103.3), identifying reward drivers of attrition (especially regrettable loss) and high-performer retention
C&B Manager recommend program adjustments (reallocate spend to high-impact rewards), report total-rewards effectiveness to CHRO/CFO and committee (links to VS-36), and update the rewards strategy
